title: How to make a paper boat
text:
You will need:
- a rectangle of paper (A4 size works well)
- a wax crayon
- a bowl of water to test your boat

What to do:
1. Fold the paper in half from top to bottom, so the fold is at the top.
2. Fold it in half from side to side to make a crease down the middle. Then open it out again.
3. Fold the two top corners down to meet at the middle crease. You now have a triangle with a strip at the bottom.
4. Fold the bottom strip up at the front. Turn the paper over and fold the other strip up too. Now you have a paper hat!
5. Pull the bottom of the hat open and push the two ends together. Press it flat to make a diamond shape.
6. Fold the bottom corner of the front layer up to the top. Turn it over and do the same on the back.
7. Pull it open again and press it flat into a smaller diamond.
8. Hold the two top points and gently pull them apart. Your boat will pop open!

Top tip: Paper boats soon get soggy. Colour the outside of your boat with the wax crayon before you sail it. The wax helps to keep the water out.
